title: An airship to live on is usable by the crew
question: Build me an airship I can live on.
player: Mid game: brass, Portable Engines, plenty of wood.
rubric: Cruises at about 8 blocks/s or better
Engines are a walk from the helm; assembler open to a floor; boarding from the ground; closed warm cabin if it climbs high
Has a bed, a place to cook, a crafting table and real storage
No fences on bottom slabs, no ballast
